design.source_policy: unchanged R116 restricted source admission, exclude 344 prior source hashes/paths, 36 new source-copy examples and 64 separate crystals
design.proposal: PyTorch AdamW on shadow parameter tensors, real model hash unchanged before applying actual displacement; raw clipped objective gradient updates moments; exact rollback on rejected or zero step
design.constraint: fresh normalized gradients of 4 weakest parent-correct pairwise margins and 4 open-token margins including >=2 historical witnesses, current highest competing token for open margins; all other old items still checked by exact veto
design.projection: cyclic halfspace correction of actual AdamW displacement in float64 Gram space, up to 24 sweeps, tolerance 1e-7*max(raw_norm,1e-12), zero step on infeasible; no nearest-point optimality claim
design.controls: raw actual displacement vs scalar shrinkage to local projected norm vs projected displacement; all arms compute same constraints and projection; same curriculum, replay and target counts
design.retention: R116 exact post-step acquisition CE, paired/open historical veto and geometry unchanged; zero steps not accepted; same final foundation and relation gates
design.decision: report acceptance, exact rollback, zero abstentions, projected feasibility, raw/applied norms and predicted vs actual constraint margin directions, old losses and new full-sequence performance; do not promote any candidate; reduction in rejected attempts alone is not learning

limits: Only selected eight local linearized margins, not all old facts; finite steps may still lose knowledge, so exact veto remains
Open competitors may switch after the step; projected float64 direction rounded to model precision
Norm matching is against the same local counterfactual at each arm's current weights, not a guarantee of equal realized norms across diverged trajectories
AdamW moments follow raw gradient, not projected displacement; this is a modified optimizer policy
All arms pay projection overhead for matched comparison; absolute runtime advantage not established
New source and seeds differ from R116; use contemporaneous raw arm, not historical acceptance as causal comparator
Historical document cohorts reused, synthetic tasks and metadata-derived facts, no independently administered blind exam
No production change, export, promotion or dependency removal
